newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor futures market closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor futures market closed for holiday.

text.p: The Bombay Oilseeds and Oils Exchange was closed on Monday for a Moslem festival.
On Friday, castorseed March delivery dropped seven rupees to 1,127/1,128 rupees per quintal on fresh speculative selling.
Castorseed June delivery dropped five rupees to 1,195/1,200 rupees per quintal but trading was nominal.
Groundnut oil lost 2.0-3.0 rupees to 336/338 rupees per 10 kg on sluggish seasonal buying and fresh arrivals. Imported palm oil also lost 2.0-3.0 rupees to 277/278 rupees per 10 kg.
